title: total_supply_equals_sum_of_balances
description: sDAI totalSupply equals the sum of balanceOf over all accounts.

title: shares_equal_pot_pie
description: The normalized savings balance pie that the Pot records for the sDAI contract equals sDAI totalSupply: every share is backed by exactly one unit of pie and no pie is unaccounted for.

title: pot_total_pie_covers_sdai_pie
description: The Pot's total normalized savings Pie is at least the pie it records for sDAI (sDAI's exit can never underflow the Pot's totals).

title: pot_vat_dai_covers_savings
description: The Pot's internal Vat dai balance is at least chi * Pie, so every unit of pie can be paid out at the current accumulator.

title: daijoin_vat_dai_covers_dai_supply
description: DaiJoin's internal Vat dai balance is at least RAY * DAI totalSupply, so any outstanding DAI can be joined back into the Vat (DaiJoin is the only minter of DAI).

title: sdai_setup_permissions_persist
description: The permissions sDAI grants in its constructor persist forever: Vat.can[sDAI][DaiJoin] == 1, Vat.can[sDAI][Pot] == 1, and DAI.allowance[sDAI][DaiJoin] == max uint256.
